earlier_scan.source_named: Hosali, Priya. 2000. Butler English: Form and Function. New Delhi: B.R. Publishing (monograph on the pidgin; prosody plausibly covered; no online copy reachable)

sources.note: No phonology section; references Hosali & Aitchison 1986, Hosali 2005, Mehrotra 1997.

sources.citation: Hosali, Priya. 1982. Butler English: Form and Function. PhD dissertation (English: Linguistics and Phonetics), Central Institute of English and Foreign Languages, Hyderabad; supervisor S.K. Verma. xxvii+733 pp. [Glottolog ref 587616, Glottolog's most extensive description 'full grammar'; open on Shodhganga hdl 10603/130425]
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing. The thesis is a sociolinguistic/syntactic/lexico-semantic description and explicitly excludes phonology: ch. IV Part III(B) fn. 2, p. 246 'Although phonology is not being discussed it may be of interest to note that Schuchardt has been able to present convincing evidence of Tamil phonological influence on the Butler English of Madras'; Part IV sec. 3.1 'Phonic', p. 332: 'Phonic transference, or the transference of sounds is not discussed here, as it is outside the scope of this study.' a full-text search for stress/accent all five chapters and appendices for stress/accent/syllable/in…

sources.citation: Schuchardt, Hugo. 1891. Beitraege zur Kenntnis des englischen Kreolisch III: Das Indo-Englische. Englische Studien 15: 286-305 (Butler English of Madras discussed pp. 292-293).
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing on accent. Only pronunciation remark: Tamil influence expected but 'von ihr aber findet sich in den obigen bruchstuecken kaum eine andeutung'; notes ye-/wo- prothesis (yevery < every) citing Caldwell.

sources.note: Morphosyntactic feature ratings and a sociolinguistic variety description; nothing on phonology or stress.
